thread:
priya: Quick heads-up - scheduling staged micro-rollout for engine/quant-matmul-slim v3 tonight in the quiet window (00:15-02:00 UTC). Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 50% -> 100% with manual approval between 50->100.

alex: Sounds good. Which regions for the early stages?

priya: Stage1 = us-west-2 (1%), stage2 = eu-central (5%), stage3 = global 50% (exclude ap-south for now), final = global 100%.

zach: Please enable kv-cache primer and model-variant fallback to matmul-safe. Last run saw p95 mem spike around 4k tokens.

priya: Done - warmup probe + fallback to matmul-safe enabled. Also turning on per-node OOM + thermal alerts.

deploy-bot: @priya deploy scheduled at 00:20 UTC. Command queued: `/deploy engine:quant-matmul-slim:v3 --stages 1,5,50,100 --regions us-west-2,eu-central,global --quiet-window 00:15-02:00UTC`

marie: Release notes draft uploaded: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/engine-matmul-slim-v3.md. Included perf wins and a long-context caveat.

alex: Rollback criteria proposal: error rate >0.4% sustained for 3m OR p99 >10% above baseline for 5m OR thermal >80C on >2 GPUs.

ops-bot: Approval card created: ENG-8401 for 50%->100% gate. Assignees: alex, oncall. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-8401

deploy-bot: Stage1 live in us-west-2 (1%). Metrics snapshot: throughput 520rps, p99 40ms, errors 0.02%. Will report again in 5m.

zach: Quick log note: "ERR kernel_quant: batch_overflow at 00:21:12" - pushing full trace to dash (link).

priya: Acknowledged. Monitoring mem/thermal. If next report shows p99 >9% above baseline, we'll auto-pin and abort.

deploy-bot: 5m canary report: p99 = 44ms (+10% vs baseline), errors = 0.03%, thermal = 72C. Holding before stage2 pending ops approval.

alex: Holding. I want one more 5m window to confirm trend. :eyes:

marie: I'm holding docs publish until final sweep. Will prepare social-friendly blurb if we go green. :spiral_note_pad:

zach: Mitigation applied in canary buckets: reduce batch size for long-context requests. Config snippet: `MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=2048`.

priya: Thanks. If next 5m improves, proceed to stage2. Otherwise we'll pin to v2 and open a postmortem.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Next update +5m.

ops-bot: Note: if pinned, will create rollback incident and annotate runbook entry.

priya: Thanks everyone. I'll watch the dashboards and call roll-forward or pin based on the next sample.
